description: Enrols an Ed25519 public key. The keypair is generated and kept on the agent's own machine, so this needs local script execution; this server never sees a private key. With no domain the key is enrolled at once under a handle derived from it, so there is nothing to choose and nothing to squat. A domain that publishes the key at its Web Bot Auth directory claims a name instead.

domain.description: Optional. A domain you control that publishes this key.

handle.description: Optional, and only honoured with a domain. Ignored otherwise.

pubkey.description: The Ed25519 public key: 32 raw bytes, base64url.

name: register
title: Enrol an agent
